waypoints.name: Goodell Creek / Upper Goodell Group Camp trailhead (SR-20, Newhalem)
waypoints.note: Standard access point for all Southern Pickets objectives via Hwy 20 near Newhalem; not route-specific beta, but no other approach is documented for this remote buttress.
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount, drive SR-20 east about 13 miles to just past milepost 119. Immediately after crossing the Goodell Creek bridge, turn left and follow the gravel road past a gravel pit and up to its end at the Upper Goodell Group Camp. Park there; the unmarked climbers' path up Goodell Creek starts behind the camp. Overnight stays need a backcountry permit from the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center.
